title: strobilanthes viscosa
intro: Strobilanthes viscosa, commonly known as the sticky strobilanthes or the sticky flowering plant, is a flowering plant species in the family Acanthaceae. This plant is believed to possess various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of conditions such as fever and skin infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
